common_prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE individual finished portrait3:4 Earl Grey Matcha Latte poster for128am Cafe.
Reference1 is the actual product photograph IMG_2010.jpg and governs real cup silhouette: compact clear rounded dessert/sundae cup, gentle taper, rounded lower corners, neither tall takeaway cup nor oversized wide bowl. A finished cup with dome should occupy roughly half the image width. BODY excluding dome should have front-rim-to-base height about0.8–0.9 of rim width at a near-frontal angle. Do not count dome height as body. Do not magnify or distort the rim. Reference2 is the cleaned Earl Grey product poster: use its amber Earl Grey syrup base, creamy matcha/milk, off-white cream topping, clear dome and small accurate girl-and-TWO-EARED-rabbit128am Cafe sticker. A style reference, if supplied, governs style only, not its drink or colours of foam.
The actual requested product is Earl Grey Matcha Latte: a modest visible amber/tea-brown Earl Grey syrup layer at bottom, milk merging softly into thick opaque creamy green matcha, a modest smooth OFF-WHITE/cream topping with a little matcha powder. No strawberry/red fruit layer, no pink strawberry foam, no lavender or purple syrup. Clean rim and outer cup; no overflowing liquid. Preserve real cup structure and legible undistorted small logo. Finished cups have a hemispherical clear DOME lid. Only designated pouring, ingredient and close-up concepts intentionally use OPEN cups.
Soft ethereal natural product photography, diffuse light, fine subtle film grain, realistic creamy textures. No hyper-sharp fake droplets or CGI ice. Keep the cup firmly on a physical surface with attached shadow; no floating product even in halo/cloud scenes. Ingredient elements may float only in falling-ingredients concept.
Exact required product text 'Earl Grey Matcha Latte' and brand '128am Cafe', spelled correctly, elegant readable type with cursive/serif or rounded retro pairing as specified. All text comfortably8–10% inset, no clipped letters. Product fully visible except deliberate close-up compositions. No price, medical/health, organic, ceremonial, Japanese origin or award claims. No extra brand, watermark, dates, or slogan 'Iced. Creamy. Lovely.' No em dashes. Do not copy other reference text or labels. One image, not a collage of multiple posters.
